aboutUs.title: Who are we?
aboutUs.p1: In this wonderful dream we have brought together an extraordinary team of very diverse people, united by a common vision, to create an exceptional tourism project in a dream location.
aboutUs.p2: Luis Antúnez is the CEO and creator of the idea, with vast experience in the world of luxury tourism and international gourmet gastronomy, having achieved numerous official recognitions in his tourism ventures, such as being considered the best tourism establishment in the country, an award granted by the Ministry of Tourism of Chile for his hotel in Patagonia.
aboutUs.p3: From his early days working at the UNWTO (World Tourism Organization) he discovered his passion for this sector, specialising in high-end tourism, with first-class clients: actors, singers and public figures such as Robert Redford, Tom Selleck, John Denver and a very long list who, after decades of work, have given him an exclusive captive market of more than four hundred thousand users and a first-class reputation in this market.
aboutUs.p4: Driven by his passion for nature and fly fishing, Luis has travelled the planet opening destinations and operations in many exclusive corners of the world, bringing all that experience, know-how and knowledge to the construction of this exclusive Project.
aboutUs.p5: Our philosophy is based on creating a unique environment for unique people, aware of the importance of working with the dreams of those who visit us — dreams are something we take very seriously.
aboutUs.p6: We base our idea on our special interpretation of luxury, which lies in exclusivity, avoiding mass tourism at all times;
aboutUs.p7: Luxury cannot go hand in hand with establishments that operate with hundreds of people; we want to put your name to each of our visitors, providing them with an absolutely personalised service that bears no resemblance to what traditionally means staying in a hotel.
aboutUs.p8: We base our success on loyalty and repeat visits from our clients; some have been visiting us for more than eighteen years, not only at our infrastructure in Patagonia but also at multiple destinations around the world, such as the Amazon, the Caribbean and Spain.
aboutUs.p9: In Spain, our team will be made up of talents in the different areas needed to achieve the degree of exclusivity we need and will bring to the project — people with genuine sensitivity who will contribute their creativity, with experience in Spanish hospitality, customer service, furniture design, decoration and gastronomy, and a complete understanding of tourism, its management and guest care.
aboutUs.p10: We have technicians specialised in landscaping who will design an oasis within the property, as well as water experts and other staff we will recruit locally and train to ensure that the harmony of the whole lives up to the Project and exceeds our guests' expectations, while also ensuring the Project has a definitive impact on the Community, achieving full employment among its inhabitants, with quality and stable jobs, creating a unique, innovative, profitable and sustainable idea.

bugarra.title: Bugarra
bugarra.p1: Focused on building fourteen fully equipped luxury bungalows ready to welcome an upscale clientele, with a gourmet restaurant, pools, spas and a full range of tourist activities.
bugarra.p2: We are awaiting the final permits to proceed and aim to be open and operational by 2027.

peralejos.title: Peralejos
peralejos.p1: Focused on building and developing a six-star hotel along with ten bungalows, a gourmet restaurant, hydrotherapy areas, pools, gyms, spas, tourist activities, online shop, vehicle rental and guide services, among other features, in the heart of the privileged Alto Tajo Natural Park in Peralejos de Las Truchas, Guadalajara — a project we started more than two years ago and which is in full development and design phase.
peralejos.p2: We will have around thirty rooms, ranging from nearly one hundred to four hundred square metres, gourmet dining and a wealth of exquisite details that will give the Project the highest reputation and prestige in Spain and abroad. The Project will be developed in phases, with many constructions and infrastructures already completed.
peralejos.p3: We aim to be ready by 2026-2027 with all luxury bungalow capacity, common areas, saunas, pools, spas, landscaping, solar fields and many more details, and by 2027-2028 to be fully operational with the rest of the Project's constructions and infrastructures.

theLake.title: The Lake
theLake.p1: In Gestalgar, Valencia, we will implement an artificial lake with two water bodies of about 35,000 square metres each, intended for sports activities, especially catch-and-release sport fishing which, given the area's climate, will make it the largest destination in Spain and most of Europe — with the curious fact that in winter, while the rest of Spain and Europe is below zero, temperatures there will be between 15 and 20 degrees.
theLake.p2: National and international competitions will be held and it will support the Bugarra Project.

tajoSuite.name: Tajo Suite
tajoSuite.description: Spacious suite with river views and natural wood finishes.
tajoSuite.detail: The Tajo Suite blends local wood warmth with wide windows facing the Tago river. It includes a separate lounge, private terrace and preferred spa access. Designed for guests seeking intimacy and nature without giving up six-star comfort.
tajoSuite.bathroom: Marble bathroom with bathtub and rain shower

lagoonJunior.name: Lagoon Junior
lagoonJunior.description: Bright room with private balcony and contemporary design.
lagoonJunior.detail: The Lagoon Junior stands out for its brightness and private balcony over the park landscape. Contemporary décor with designer textiles and bespoke furniture. Ideal for couples seeking elegance and warmth.

presidential.name: Presidential Suite
presidential.description: The ultimate expression of luxury with separate lounge and panoramic terrace.
presidential.detail: Our most exclusive suite offers over one hundred eighty square metres with reception lounge, private dining, panoramic terrace and heated pool. Includes twenty-four-hour butler service and access to all premium resort facilities.
presidential.bedType: King-size bed and sofa bed in lounge
presidential.bathroom: Two marble bathrooms with jacuzzi and private hammam

gardenBungalow.name: Garden Bungalow
gardenBungalow.description: Standalone bungalow integrated into the Mediterranean garden.
gardenBungalow.detail: Independent bungalow surrounded by Mediterranean vegetation with direct access to a private garden. Designer fireplace, outdoor shower and terrace with lounge area. An intimate experience blending contemporary architecture and nature.
gardenBungalow.bathroom: Bathroom with indoor and outdoor shower

spaSuite.name: Spa Suite
spaSuite.description: Suite with private access to wellness and hydrotherapy circuit.
spaSuite.detail: Suite designed for holistic wellness with private access to the hydrotherapy circuit, sauna and relaxation terrace. Natural materials, adjustable lighting and aromatherapy included with every stay.

lakeView.name: Lake View
lakeView.description: Floor-to-ceiling windows with direct lake and mountain views.
lakeView.detail: Generously sized room with floor-to-ceiling windows facing the artificial lake and Valencian mountains. Perfect for small families or extended stays with integrated seating area.
lakeView.bathroom: Double bathroom with shower and bathtub

fisherLodge.name: Fisher Lodge
fisherLodge.description: Luxury rustic retreat designed for fly fishing.
fisherLodge.detail: Refined rustic lodge with direct access to the lakeshore. Includes premium fishing equipment, fly-tying area and private terrace to watch sunrise over the water.
fisherLodge.bathroom: Shower bathroom with decorative wood stove

panorama.name: Panorama Suite
panorama.description: Elevated suite with 180° views over the water landscape.
panorama.detail: Elevated suite with unobstructed one-hundred-eighty-degree views over the lake and mountains. Lounge with premium bar, wide terrace and priority access to water sports and sport fishing.
panorama.bathroom: Panoramic window bathroom with rain shower

executive.name: Executive Room
executive.description: Elegant room with work area and personalised service.
executive.detail: Functional elegant room with large desk, high-speed connectivity and discreet room service. Designed for discerning travellers combining work and rest in an exceptional natural setting.
